title: This AI lab has never sold a single product. It just raised $1 billion.
caption:
This AI lab has never sold a single product. It just raised $1 billion.

It's a year old and named after an airplane that flaps its wings: not a bird, not a giant airliner, something in between.

Its bet: AI that learns more like a brain, from far less data than today's chatbots.

In January it was valued at a reported $1.5B. Now a reported $6B. Still no product.

Would you bet a billion dollars on a lab with no product?
